etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin victōriōsus, from victōria (“victory”), from victor (“conqueror”). Displaced native Old English siġefæst.

definitions.definition: Being the winner in a contest, struggle, war, etc.

quote.text: They will not force us, / They will stop degrading us, / They will not control us, / We will be victorious!

definitions.definition: Of or expressing a sense of victory or triumph.
